standards.caption: Selected JCSEE standards and review-specific operational questions. These questions adapt the standards to published evaluation evidence; they do not constitute an official certification instrument.
rows: Does the reported information address the stated evaluation purpose and the Perceived Effects under investigation?
Is the interpretation of the subjective indicator supported by a defensible connection among the Perceived Effects, operationalization, and measure?
Is the dependability or credibility of the information supported by evidence appropriate to the measurement and analysis?
A4 Explicit Program and Context Descriptions
Are the evaluation object, participants, task, and setting described sufficiently to interpret the findings?
Are the evaluation design and analysis appropriate for the question and the strength of the reported claim?
Can the reasoning from collected information through analysis to the reported conclusion be traced?
Are the measures, procedures, scoring, results, and source locations documented sufficiently for scrutiny?

audit.caption: Provisional operational classifications of reported support across 514 candidate records. Counts describe the recorded screening outputs and are not verified assessments of study quality or JCSEE certification.
audit.note: S: sufficient support according to the operational screen; P: partial support; C: explicit concern; NR: not reported or indeterminate; NA: deemed inapplicable. Source-specific validation is outstanding. Inspection of retained support statements identified substantive mismatches in some A2 and A3 classifications. Every row totals 514; A3 contains 40 NA records.

models.caption: Expanded-screen conditional prediction results over ten repetitions of cross-validation grouped by paper. Macro-F1 is reported as mean ± SD across data splits; SD is not a population confidence interval.
models.note: All non-baseline rows use the same fixed regularized logistic-regression specification. Known evidence is the selected Perceived Effects dimension for indicator prediction and the selected dimension plus indicator for tool prediction. G4 and derived G5 are excluded. Tool records are individual tool instances. Metrics are pooled over out-of-fold predictions within each repetition. Equal-paper-weighted scoring reverses the indicator ordering between known-evidence-only and context-plus-known-evidence (macro-F1 .321 versus .305), limiting claims of incremental contextual benefit.

indicators.note: Indicator codes belong to the review taxonomy and should not be confused with similarly named JCSEE standard codes. Five Perceived Effects dimensions contain these indicators: A design outcome quality; B design process quality; C designer cognition, affect, and capability; D human–AI interaction experience; E social and contextual value. Six additional records map to a dimension but not to a specific indicator.
